acip: ZHES RAB RIB CAN LA RAB RIB MED PAS SKRA SHAD MED DO ZHES BSTAN KYANG, RAB RIB MED PAS MTHONG BA 'DRA BA'I SKRA SHAD MED PA MI RTOGS PAR GSUNGS PAS, NYAN PA POS DE LTAR MA RTOGS KYANG SKRA SHAD MED PA MI RTOGS PA MIN NO,,
english: What this is saying is that a person who has no cataracts can say to a person who still does have them, “There's no strand of hair there!”—but the latter person will not be able to realize the lack of a hair there in the same way that the person with no cataracts sees this. We can say though that even though the person listening to the correct explanation cannot realize this object in the same way, it's not though the case that they have no realization at all then that there is no hair there.
